caption:
"My team won't use it." That's the objection Black Arrow hears most before an owner opens a CRM.

Here's the pattern across CRM rollouts: unclear ownership and thin training stall adoption. The platform works. The rollout doesn't.

The fix is a smaller first step.

Automate the parts that need zero login first: missed-call text-back, review requests. Add the shared inbox for your crew only after leads start moving on their own.

Test it on your own pipeline before your crew touches a thing.

DM TRIAL

rationale: Carousels lead 2026 saves/depth for B2B objection content, and this resolves the genuinely unclaimed team-adoption fear with an honest industry pattern and a phased rollout distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, lock-in, complexity, and spam objection already shipped.
